subcategory_text: Select, integrate, and maintain toolchains for dataset management, model training/fine-tuning, evaluation, model packaging, and deployment that meet AI-specific security requirements.
implementation_examples: Adopt an experiment-tracking system with cryptographic integrity
Use feature stores with version pinning and audit logs
Use a model registry that enforces signed model artefacts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the AI toolchain covers data, training, evaluation, and deployment with integrity controls.
Determine whether AI toolchain components are inventoried and pinned.
